newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Red Cross urges release of hostages in Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross urges release of hostages in Tajikistan.

text.p: The International Committee of the Red Cross said on Wednesday it deplored the capture of two of its staffers by Tajik rebels and called for their immediate release.

An expatriate ICRC employee and an interpreter, as well as five Russian reporters were taken hostage by Tajik rebels on Wednesday in the central Garm valley of the remote, mountainous republic a day after the same group seized five U.N. personnel.
An ICRC statement said the rebels had made no demands for ransom so far.
"The ICRC deplores this abduction...and is calling upon all those with influence in the area to take every possible step to ensure the speedy release of all hostages," it said.
The rebel group is demanding safe passage for its members based in Afghanistan back into the former Soviet republic.
